description: builds the current 2025 tax progress page through rol_finances adws/adw_tax_progress_page.py, puts it on top of ADW Generated on the live dashboard, and relays the line it writes
notes: Dispatcher only: the workflow is code, read-only (no AI, no database or answer writes). It publishes Barnes_2025_Tax_Progress_<time>.html to agent_blocks/adws/adw_data/web_pages (served by the dashboard at /adw_generated/, newest first, from disk -- no dashboard restart) and copies it to the dashboard host when run elsewhere.
